name: June Park

immutable.hair: dark brown to black, straight with soft layers, collarbone length, worn loose
immutable.skin: light-medium with subtle freckles; strong jawline
immutable.watch: white dial, dark strap, LEFT wrist

variable: production badge on a black lanyard
white hard hat in the factory hall (no text)
generator_errors: olive-green clothing (the identity pack shows the banned L1 jacket)
face mixed with Maya or Olivia in a shared chat

looks.L5: burgundy chunky knit sweater, black trousers, light sneakers, badge on a black lanyard, clipboard; caramel overcoat at night; white-dial watch with dark strap on the left wrist; gold-buckle belt (EP03, V78)
looks.L4: cream sand overshirt, white tee, black cargo, sneakers, badge, clipboard (EP02, V54)

voice.register: dry, fast, American, medium-low, deadpan timing (V38)

camera: subtle handheld, from the edges: behind glass, in profile, from a distance (E14)
interpretation_rule: June watches from the edge and says the minimum. Her irony lives in her eyes and one corner of her mouth; her voice has the timing. When the truth lands, her hands stop and she does not pretend to have an answer. She never cries.

limits.lying: never lies on screen; she stays silent instead

forbidden: wide smile at her own joke
generation_suffix: Straight dark-brown-to-black hair, loose at collarbone length. Dark brown eyes, subtle freckles. NO olive-green clothing anywhere. No smile unless the panel asks for one, and never an open laugh. If the left wrist shows, a white-dial watch with a dark strap. Same face in every panel; never Maya's or Olivia's face.

expressions.name: Observando pela borda
expressions.direction: Watching from the edge of the frame, in profile, still and attentive; she sees everything and says nothing.

expressions.name: Focada (laptop, prancheta)
expressions.direction: Eyes down on her laptop or clipboard, efficient and absorbed, a small crease between the brows.

expressions.name: A pergunta inconveniente
expressions.direction: Head slightly tilted, a level, patient look that has just asked the question nobody wanted asked.

expressions.name: A produtora resolvendo
expressions.direction: Pragmatic and unbothered, already solving the problem: brisk, practical, eyebrows level.

expressions.name: Deadpan seco
expressions.where: EP01 ("Remarkable. You heard an entire noun.")
expressions.direction: A perfectly still face delivering a dry line; not a trace of a smile; irony only in the eyes.

expressions.name: Ironia nos olhos e no canto da boca
expressions.direction: Irony in the eyes and one corner of the mouth barely lifted; dryly amused, nothing more.

expressions.name: O diagnóstico curto
expressions.direction: A flat, unimpressed look, eyelids slightly lowered, delivering a one-line verdict.

expressions.name: O olhar "sério?"
expressions.direction: One eyebrow barely raised, mouth flat, staring at someone who has just said something absurd.

expressions.name: Duelo com Maya
expressions.direction: A calm, polite, immovable look across the table, chin level; she will not give an inch, and she likes her opponent.

expressions.name: A mão sobre a tampa
expressions.direction: Her hand resting flat on a box lid, eyes calmly meeting someone else's, protecting it without a word.

expressions.name: Calorosa
expressions.direction: A rare warmth in the eyes for her friend, the face softening, a tiny closed-mouth curve.

expressions.name: Preocupação firme e gentil
expressions.direction: Firm, gentle concern: eyes steady on Olivia, brows slightly drawn, lips closed; she will not let her run.

expressions.name: Protetora de Olivia
expressions.direction: Standing a little closer to Olivia, quietly blocking, eyes level on whoever is asking.

expressions.name: Confrontando Olivia
expressions.where: EP01 ("You can't spend seven years rehearsing a conversation...")
expressions.direction: Looking straight at Olivia without blinking, hands stopped, saying the one true sentence.

expressions.name: Empurrando Olivia ("Does Claire know?")
expressions.direction: A direct, quiet look that asks the question Olivia avoids; patient and relentless.

expressions.name: Guardando o segredo ("Not my story.")
expressions.direction: Closed, calm face, eyes on her work, giving nothing away; she won't lie and she won't tell.

expressions.name: Desconfortável com a pergunta
expressions.direction: A flicker of discomfort when asked about Olivia: eyes slide away, jaw tightens slightly, hands keep working.

expressions.name: Sem resposta
expressions.direction: Eyes lowered, mouth closed; she has no answer and doesn't pretend to.

expressions.name: O peso do segredo
expressions.direction: Alone for a moment, tired eyes on nothing; seven years of being the only one who knows.

expressions.name: Séria (sem deadpan)
expressions.direction: Serious and honest, no irony at all: eyes on what matters, face still.

expressions.name: As mãos param
expressions.direction: Her hands stop in the middle of a task and stay still; her eyes go still too.

expressions.name: Tristeza contida (não chora)
expressions.direction: Sad without crying: eyes lowered, jaw set, a long breath out; no tears, ever.

expressions.name: Cansada (fim do dia)
expressions.direction: End-of-day tired: heavy lids, head resting back, the professional face off.

expressions.name: O sorriso de canto (raríssimo)
expressions.direction: A rare, small, crooked half-smile that she allows for one second.

expressions.name: Aliança com Maya
expressions.direction: A small, knowing nod across the room: an understanding with an old rival.

expressions.name: Alívio quando Olivia conta
expressions.direction: Relief: a long breath out, eyes closing for a moment, shoulders dropping; finally not the only one who knows.
